# Load libraries and functions
```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(ggrepel)
library(writexl)
```

```{r}
# Connect to UniProt database (human, taxon 9606)
up <- UniProt.ws(taxId = 9606)

# Maps UniProt accessions to gene names and filters peptides belonging to CTA genes
map_genes_to_peptides <- function(df_summary) {
  # Expand rows so each protein accession is on its own line
  df_sep <- df_summary %>%
    mutate(RowID = row_number()) %>%
    separate_rows(Prot_accessions, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
    mutate(Prot_accessions = sub("-\\d+$", "", Prot_accessions))

  # Query UniProt to retrieve primary gene names
  gene_mapping <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    up,
    keys = unique(df_sep$Prot_accessions),
    columns = "gene_primary",
    keytype = "UniProtKB"
  )

  # Merge gene names back and collapse per peptide sequence
  df_merged <- df_sep %>%
    left_join(gene_mapping, by = c("Prot_accessions" = "Entry"))

  df_final <- df_merged %>%
    group_by(Seq) %>%
    summarise(
      Proteins = paste(unique(Prot_accessions), collapse = "; "),
      Genes = paste(unique(Gene.Names..primary.), collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Join back to the original dataframe and keep only CTA peptides
  df_summary %>%
    left_join(df_final, by = "Seq") %>%
    filter(Genes %in% l_CTA)
}
```


# Load data
```{r, fig.cap="Peptides length histogram (MHC-I)"}
# Load CTA gene list
l_CTA <- read.table("../data/CTA_list_clean.txt")$V1

# Load full immunopeptidomic dataset (IFNg experiment, both cell lines)
df_complete <- read.csv("../data/immunopep_all_clean.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T)

# Keep only canonical MHC-I peptides (length 8–11 aa)
df_complete <- df_complete[df_complete$Sequence.Length >= 8 & df_complete$Sequence.Length <= 11,]

# Keep only canonical sequences (exclude non-canonical or ambiguous entries)
df_complete <- df_complete[df_complete$Marked.as %in% "Cannonic" | df_complete$Marked.as %in% "Cannonic;Mut",]

# Load NetMHCpan affinity prediction results (all alleles)
df_aff <- read.table("../data/table_res_netmhc_all.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T)

# Load IEDB MHC-I reference epitopes
df_iedb_mhc1 <- read.csv("../data/epitope_table_export_human_MHC_I.tsv", header = T, sep = "\t")
df_pep_mhc1 <- df_iedb_mhc1[, c("Name", "Source.Molecule.IRI", "Molecule.Parent.IRI")]

# Extract clean peptide sequences from IEDB (remove modifications and adducts)
pep_iedb_mhc1 <- unique(df_pep_mhc1$Name)
pep_iedb_mhc1 <- gsub(" .*|\\+.*", "", pep_iedb_mhc1)
```


# I. MHC-I differential analysis (IFNg vs NoIFNg)

## 1) All peptides volcano plot
### CH2879
```{r, fig.cap="Volcano plot all CH2879"}
# Prepare data
df_ch_all <- data.frame(
  pep = df_complete$Annotated.Sequence,
  log2_ratio = log2(df_complete$Abundance.Ratio...CH2879..INF.....CH2879..NoINF.),
  log10_p = -log10(df_complete$Abundance.Ratio.Adj..P.Value...CH2879..INF.....CH2879..NoINF.),
  Contaminant = df_complete$Contaminant
)

# Remove rows with missing values
df_ch_all <- na.omit(df_ch_all)

# Categorise peptides
df_ch_all$category <- ifelse(df_ch_all$log2_ratio > 1  & df_ch_all$log10_p > -log10(0.05), "Upregulated",
                      ifelse(df_ch_all$log2_ratio < -1 & df_ch_all$log10_p > -log10(0.05), "Downregulated",
                             "Not significant"))
table_sig <- table(df_ch_all$category)

# Volcano plot
p <- ggplot(df_ch_all, aes(x = log2_ratio, y = log10_p)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = category), alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    labs(
      x = "Log2 Ratio",
      y = "-log10(adj. p-value)",
      color = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 3,  
           y = max(df_ch_all$log10_p, na.rm = TRUE) + 2,
           label = table_sig["Upregulated"],
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4) +
  annotate("text",
           x = -3,
           y = max(df_ch_all$log10_p, na.rm = TRUE) + 2,
           label = table_sig["Downregulated"],
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4)
p
ggsave("../results/v_plot_mhc1_ch.svg", plot = p, width = 5, height = 5)
```

### Gene annotation of all peptides
```{r}
# Expand protein accessions (one per row) and strip isoform suffixes
df_sep <- df_complete %>%
  mutate(RowID = row_number()) %>%
  separate_rows(Master.Protein.Accessions, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
  mutate(Master.Protein.Accessions = sub("-\\d+$", "", Master.Protein.Accessions))

# Query UniProt to get primary gene names for all accessions
up <- UniProt.ws(taxId = 9606)

gene_mapping <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  up,
  keys = df_sep$Master.Protein.Accessions,
  columns = "gene_primary",
  keytype = "UniProtKB"
)

# Merge gene names and collapse multiple genes per peptide
df_merged <- df_sep %>%
  left_join(gene_mapping, by = c("Master.Protein.Accessions" = "Entry"))

df_final <- df_merged %>%
  group_by(Annotated.Sequence) %>%
  summarise(
    Proteins = paste(unique(Master.Protein.Accessions), collapse = "; "),
    Genes = paste(unique(Gene.Names..primary.), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join gene names back to the full peptide table
df_final_pep <- df_complete %>%
  left_join(df_final, by = "Annotated.Sequence")

# Restrict to CTA-derived peptides
df_final_pep_cta <- df_final_pep[df_final_pep$Genes %in% l_CTA,]
```

### Upregulated peptides (all genes)
```{r}
# Subset upregulated peptides in JJ012
df_jj_all_up <- df_jj_all[df_jj_all$category %in% "Upregulated",]

# Remove duplicate annotated sequences to get one row per unique peptide
df_final_pep_unique <- df_final_pep[!duplicated(df_final_pep$Annotated.Sequence), ]

# Merge volcano data with gene annotation
df_jj_all_up_table <- merge(df_jj_all_up, df_final_pep_unique,
                             by.x = "pep", by.y = "Annotated.Sequence", all.x = TRUE)

df_jj_all_up_table <- df_jj_all_up_table %>%
  filter(category == "Upregulated") %>%
  arrange(desc(log2_ratio))

# Extract clean peptide sequence (strip flanking residues from annotated format)
df_jj_all_up_table$Peptide <- gsub("^.*\\.(.*)\\..*$", "\\1", df_jj_all_up_table$pep)
df_jj_all_up_table$pvalue <- 10^(-df_jj_all_up_table$log10_p)
df_jj_all_up_table$Gene <- df_jj_all_up_table$Genes
df_jj_all_up_table <- df_jj_all_up_table[, c("Gene", "Peptide", "log2_ratio", "pvalue")]

```

```{r, fig.cap="Volcano plot CTAs CH2879"}
# Build volcano dataframe restricted to CTA-derived peptides (CH2879)
df_ch_cta <- data.frame(
  Genes = df_final_pep_cta$Genes,
  pep = df_final_pep_cta$Annotated.Sequence,
  log2_ratio = log2(df_final_pep_cta$Abundance.Ratio...CH2879..INF.....CH2879..NoINF.),
```

# III. Venn diagrams
```{r}
# Extract UniProt IDs from IEDB parent molecule IRIs and map to gene names
df_iedb_mhc1$ID <- gsub("http://www.uniprot.org/uniprot/", "", df_iedb_mhc1$Molecule.Parent.IRI)
df_iedb_mhc1$ID <- sub("-.*", "", df_iedb_mhc1$ID)

up <- UniProt.ws(taxId = 9606)
gene_mapping <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  up,
  keys = unique(df_iedb_mhc1$ID[df_iedb_mhc1$ID != ""]),
  columns = "gene_primary",
  keytype = "UniProtKB")
colnames(gene_mapping) <- c("From", "ID", "Gene.Names..primary.")
df_iedb_mhc1_name <- merge(df_iedb_mhc1, gene_mapping, by.x = "ID", all.x = TRUE)

# Keep only IEDB epitopes from CTA genes
df_iedb_mhc1_cta <- df_iedb_mhc1_name[df_iedb_mhc1_name$Gene.Names..primary. %in% l_CTA, ]
```


```{r}
# Clean IEDB peptide sequences (strip modifications)
pep_iedb_mhc1_cta <- unique(df_iedb_mhc1_cta$Name)
pep_iedb_mhc1_cta <- gsub(" .*|\\+.*", "", pep_iedb_mhc1_cta)
pep_iedb_mhc1_cta <- unique(pep_iedb_mhc1_cta)

# Identify novel peptides (not in IEDB, not a substring of any IEDB peptide)
new_pep_ch_mhc1 <- setdiff(df_up_ch$Peptide, pep_iedb_mhc1_cta)
# Check whether any novel peptide is a substring of an IEDB peptide
grep_ch <- sapply(new_pep_ch_mhc1, function(x) any(grepl(x, pep_iedb_mhc1_cta)))
new_pep_ch_mhc1 <- new_pep_ch_mhc1[!new_pep_ch_mhc1 %in% names(grep_ch)[grep_ch]]
df_ch_new_pep_mhc1 <- df_up_ch %>%
  filter(Peptide %in% new_pep_ch_mhc1) %>%
  distinct(Peptide, .keep_all = TRUE)

# JJ012
new_pep_jj_mhc1 <- setdiff(df_up_jj$Peptide, pep_iedb_mhc1_cta)
grep_jj <- sapply(new_pep_jj_mhc1, function(x) any(grepl(x, pep_iedb_mhc1_cta)))
new_pep_jj_mhc1 <- new_pep_jj_mhc1[!new_pep_jj_mhc1 %in% names(grep_jj)[grep_jj]]

df_jj_new_pep_mhc1 <- df_up_jj %>%
  filter(Peptide %in% new_pep_jj_mhc1) %>%
  distinct(Peptide, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Extended IEDB sets (original + substring matches)
pep_iedb_extended_ch <- unique(c(pep_iedb_mhc1_cta, names(grep_ch)[grep_ch]))
pep_iedb_extended_jj <- unique(c(pep_iedb_mhc1_cta, names(grep_jj)[grep_jj]))
```

```{r, fig.cap="Venn plot JJ012 (MHCI)"}
# Venn diagram: overlap between IFNg-upregulated CTA peptides and IEDB reference epitopes
grid.newpage()
venn <- draw.pairwise.venn(
  area1 = length(pep_iedb_extended_jj),
  area2 = length(df_up_jj$Peptide),
  cross.area = length(df_up_jj$Peptide) - length(new_pep_jj_mhc1), 
  category = c("IEDB", "JJ012"),
  fill = c("#2C7BB6", "#ff7f0e"),
  scaled = FALSE)
grid.draw(venn)
```

# IV. HLA binding affinity

```{r}
# Keep only predictions matching upregulated CTA peptides
df_aff_ch_hlaa0101 <- df_aff[df_aff$Allele == "HLA-A0101" & df_aff$Peptide %in% df_up_ch$Peptide, c("Peptide", "Affinity", "Rank")]

df_aff_jj_hlaa0201 <- df_aff[df_aff$Allele == "HLA-A0201" & df_aff$Peptide %in% df_up_jj$Peptide, c("Peptide", "Affinity", "Rank")]
```

## CH2879
```{r}
# Identify known peptides for CH2879 (in IEDB or substring matches)
pep_commons <- intersect(df_up_ch$Peptide, pep_iedb_mhc1_cta)
pep_commons2 <- names(grep_ch)[grep_ch]
pep_known_all <- union(pep_commons, pep_commons2)

# Combine novel and known peptides for annotation
df_iedb_new_pep_ch <- df_up_ch %>%
  filter(Peptide %in% new_pep_ch_mhc1 | Peptide %in% pep_known_all) %>%
  distinct(Peptide, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Merge with affinity predictions
df_pep_ch_hlaa0101 <- df_up_ch[df_up_ch$Peptide %in% df_aff_ch_hlaa0101$Peptide, ]
df_pep_ch_hlaa0101 <- merge(df_pep_ch_hlaa0101, df_aff_ch_hlaa0101, by = "Peptide")

df_pep_ch_hlaa0101 <- df_pep_ch_hlaa0101 %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(
    Peptide %in% new_pep_ch_mhc1 ~ "New",
    Peptide %in% pep_known_all   ~ "Known"
  ))
```

```{r, fig.cap="Scatter plot Rank CH2879"}
# Count peptides per %Rank bin and flag ranks containing novel peptides
df_count <- df_pep_ch_hlaa0101 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Status = as.character(Status)) %>%
  group_by(Rank) %>%
  summarise(
    nb_pep = n(),
    is_new = any(Status == "New"))


p <- ggplot(df_count, aes(x = nb_pep, y = Rank, color = is_new)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey30", "TRUE" = "#ff7f0e"), 
                     labels = c("FALSE" = "Known peptides", "TRUE" = "Novel peptides")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.5, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = max(df_count$nb_pep), y = 0.5 * 0.8, label = "Strong binders", hjust = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = max(df_count$nb_pep), y = 2   * 0.8, label = "Weak binders",   hjust = 1, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "CH2879 HLA-A*01:01 peptides number", y = "%Rank", color = "Category") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100), labels = c("0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", "100")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(df_count$nb_pep), by = 1)) +
  theme_minimal()
p
#ggsave("../results/scatter_ch_a01.svg", plot = p)
```

```{r}
pep_known_all <- union(pep_commons, pep_commons2)

# Combine novel and known peptides for annotation
df_iedb_new_pep_jj <- df_up_jj %>%
  filter(Peptide %in% new_pep_jj_mhc1 | Peptide %in% pep_known_all) %>%
  distinct(Peptide, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Merge with affinity predictions
df_pep_jj_hlaa0201 <- df_up_jj[df_up_jj$Peptide %in% df_aff_jj_hlaa0201$Peptide, ]
df_pep_jj_hlaa0201 <- merge(df_pep_jj_hlaa0201, df_aff_jj_hlaa0201, by.x = "Peptide", by.y = "Peptide")

df_pep_jj_hlaa0201 <- df_pep_jj_hlaa0201 %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(
    Peptide %in% new_pep_jj_mhc1 ~ "New",
    Peptide %in% pep_known_all   ~ "Known"
  ))
```

```{r, fig.cap="Scatter plot Rank JJ012"}
# Count peptides per %Rank
df_count <- df_pep_jj_hlaa0201 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Status = as.character(Status)) %>%
  group_by(Rank) %>%
  summarise(
    nb_pep = n(),
    is_new = any(Status == "New"))


p <- ggplot(df_count, aes(x = nb_pep, y = Rank, color = is_new)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey30", "TRUE" = "#ff7f0e"), 
                     labels = c("FALSE" = "Known peptides", "TRUE" = "Novel peptides")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.5, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = max(df_count$nb_pep), y = 0.5 * 0.8, label = "Strong binders", hjust = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = max(df_count$nb_pep), y = 2   * 0.8, label = "Weak binders",   hjust = 1, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "JJ012 HLA-A*02:01 peptides number", y = "%Rank", color = "Category") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100), labels = c("0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", "100")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(df_count$nb_pep), by = 2)) +
  theme_minimal()
p
#ggsave("../results/scatter_jj_a0201.svg", plot = p)
```
